parameters.name: BackendBucketRegionId
parameters.description: The region where the gateway cluster is located. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to obtain a valid region ID.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the gateway cluster. The description can be 0 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the gateway cluster. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), or hyphens (-). The name must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.
